headline: Declined nine Director applicants and reappointed Robert Soohoo as Retirement Director
summary: The Board discussed the Retirement Director position and voted not to consider the 9 applicants received because none were qualified. The Board then voted to appoint Robert Soohoo as Retirement Director under the same terms and conditions from his last day of departure. The Board also discussed an investment manager transition communication from Cambridge Trust Investments.
decisions: The Board voted not to consider the 9 applicants received for the Director's position.
The Board voted to appoint Robert Soohoo as Retirement Director under the same terms and conditions from the last day of his departure.

decision_evidence.quote: The Board made a motion not to consider the 9 applicants received for the Director's position.
The Board made a motion to accept Robert Soohoo's request and appoint him the Retirement Director under the same terms and conditions from the last day of his departure.
